text:
Q4 revenue grew 23% YoY with strong pipeline visibility into Q1. Gross margin compressed from 61% to 57% — elevated but within acquisition threshold.

Risks identified:
- FX exposure on EMEA contracts: acceptable. Currency hedges in place through Q2.
- Pending UK regulatory inquiry: elevated. No resolution timeline confirmed.

Recommendation: proceed, contingent on legal review of the UK regulatory matter within 30 days.

sections.summary: Revenue growth strong, margin compression within threshold.
